runtime.background_evidence: Installed tool-workflow lib/index.js:48-55, 204-258; published workflow schema exposes run_in_background. Job result delivers the completed value and wakes its owner.
runtime.workflow_api: agent(prompt,{label,phase,provider,model,schema}); pipeline; parallel; phase; log; args. No Node, filesystem, network or timer API in script realm. No effort/isolation/agentType agent options.

workflow_maxConcurrentAgents.basis: Installed workflow-ptc lib/index.js:597-602,630-635; base bundle has no override; availableParallelism=24 => min(16,max(1,24-2)). In-memory overrides are not independently observable.

maxActiveSubagents.basis: Installed subagent lib/index.js:2978-2980 default; no profile file override. Volatile in-memory setting not independently observable.

occupied_applicable_slots.basis: list_agents descendants returned no subagents before launch. Pool is process-local and shared down uninterrupted resident ancestry, not one universal account pool: subagent lib/types/activation.js:8-24 and manager.js:723-730.

maxDepth.basis: Default subagent service setting. Spawn supports depthLimit. Workflow startChild does not pass maxDepth (workflow-ptc lib/index.js:327-348), so this setting must not be claimed as an enforced workflow recursion cap. All workers explicitly forbidden to delegate; every task is a direct child.

maxTotalAgents.basis: Installed workflow-ptc deployment ceiling, not simultaneous capacity. Model-facing workflow schema exposes no per-run override. This script has its own bounded budget: 14 primary + at most 3 repairs + 3 verifiers + at most 2 adjudicators + 1 synthesis = 23 starts.

ptc_maxPendingCalls.basis: Installed ptc-runtime-node lib/index.js:692-699; no profile file override. Each agent involves startChild, childResult, disposeChild RPCs (workflow-ptc:301-317), plus begin/progress/control calls.

safe_ptc_capacity.basis: Conservative floor((128-8)/3), reserving 3 call allowances per scheduled agent rather than assuming one agent equals one pending RPC. RPC phases normally do not all overlap; this is a safety bound, not measured occupancy.

provider_capacity.basis: Only openai-codex advertised. No explicit concurrent request/account quota tool available; exact-name codex_connect_quota discovery returned no callable. No rate or quota guarantee inferred from model availability.

resource_capacity.basis: Operational safety estimate for read-only agents: 24 available CPUs, approximately 13.7 GB free of 33.0 GB RAM; no parallel heavy test/build workloads authorized. Not a measured per-agent memory ceiling.

limits.formula: min(16,8,40,provider_capacity_unknown,resource_operational_estimate_8,14). C=8 is conditional on unknown provider/in-memory limits; runtime admission remains authoritative. No setting is increased or bypassed.
limits.other_limits: Workflow maxItemsPerCall=4096 and synchronous script execution slice=5000ms by deployment defaults; PTC workflow uses timeoutMs:null. PTC default heap=512MB, output=64MiB, message=128MiB. Native model/tool usage/account limits remain unknown. Test concurrency is unrelated to agent concurrency. Sandbox ps sees only its PID namespace, so it cannot establish host-wide resource usage.
